description: Source code for network socket operations in hiredis, including connection setup, error handling, socket configuration, and connection management functions.

methods.name: redisContextCloseFd
methods.description: Closes the socket file descriptor in the redisContext if open.

methods.name: __redisSetErrorFromErrno
methods.description: Sets an error in redisContext based on the current errno, with an optional prefix message.

methods.name: redisSetReuseAddr
methods.description: Sets SO_REUSEADDR option on the socket.

methods.name: redisCreateSocket
methods.description: Creates a socket of specified type and assigns it to redisContext.

methods.name: redisSetBlocking
methods.description: Sets the socket to blocking or non-blocking mode.

methods.name: redisKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP keepalive on the socket with specified interval.

methods.name: redisSetTcpNoDelay
methods.description: Disables Nagle's algorithm on the socket for low-latency communication.

methods.name: redisContextTimeoutMsec
methods.description: Calculates the timeout in milliseconds from redisContext's timeval.

methods.name: redisContextWaitReady
methods.description: Waits for the socket to be ready for writing within the specified timeout.

methods.name: redisCheckSocketError
methods.description: Checks for socket errors using getsockopt(SO_ERROR).

methods.name: redisContextSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets receive and send timeout options on the socket.

methods.name: _redisContextConnectTcp
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to a specified address and port, with optional source address and timeout.

methods.name: redisContextConnectTcp
methods.description: Connects to a Redis server over TCP at given address and port.

methods.name: redisContextConnectBindTcp
methods.description: Connects to a Redis server over TCP with a specified source address.

methods.name: redisContextConnectUnix
methods.description: Connects to a Redis server over a Unix domain socket.
